items.t: Said she concluded the proposed Dominion–NextEra takeover does not provide the protections Virginians demand and should not be approved.
items.q: After listening to Virginians from different backgrounds across the Commonwealth and closely reviewing this proposal, I have concluded that it does not provide the protections Virginians demand and should not be approved.

items.t: Said the Dominion–NextEra takeover should not move forward.
items.q: The risks are too great and the protections are not enough. This takeover should not move forward.

record.t: Was sworn in as the 43rd Lieutenant Governor of Virginia.

record.t: Served in the Virginia State Senate representing the 15th District, first elected in 2019.

record.t: Announced her opposition to the proposed takeover of Dominion Energy by NextEra and released an Energy Costs Listening Tour Report.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Ghazala Hashmi today announced her opposition to the proposed takeover of Dominion Energy by Florida-based NextEra

record.t: Sent a letter to the Virginia State Corporation Commission urging it to seek answers from Dominion Energy and NextEra on 64 questions about the proposed takeover.
record.q: In July, Lieutenant Governor Hashmi sent a letter to the Virginia State Corporation Commission urging the Commissioner to seek answers from Dominion Energy and NextEra on 64 detailed questions about the proposed takeover.
